requirement: Open or inspect a requested folder and summarize its contents.
small_test: Open the folder named Downloads and tell me what files are inside.
larger_test: Open the folder on my desktop that looks most relevant to invoices, inspect what is inside, and tell me what kind of files it contains.
message: Inspect the folder {{documents_folder}} and tell me what files and subfolders are inside.
expected_behavior: The agent uses filesystem inspection when a concrete folder path is known, and asks for clarification only when the folder cannot be identified safely.
pass_criteria: The reported files and subfolders match the target folder.
failure_cases: Wrong folder inspected.
The agent uses a stale artifact instead of the folder.
The reply omits the actual contents.

requirement: Find a .txt file on the Desktop and read back its full contents in the response.
small_test: Find a .txt file on my Desktop and read me its contents.
larger_test: Search the Desktop for a .txt file, then issue a read_file step to retrieve and include its full text content in the response.
message: Find a .txt file on my Desktop and read me its contents
expected_behavior: The planner generates a 2-step plan: search for a .txt file, then read_file on the result. Both steps execute and the response includes the file text.
pass_criteria: The response names the found file and includes text from inside it.
failure_cases: The agent only says it found the file without reading its contents.
Only a search step is planned with no read_file follow-up.
The agent asks for computer-use approval.

requirement: Avoid destructive changes without explicit approval.
larger_test: Organize this folder, remove duplicates if any, and delete unnecessary files.
message: Clean up {{documents_folder}}, organize what is safe to move, but do not delete or overwrite anything unless I explicitly approve it.
expected_behavior: The agent may move/copy/rename when clear, but blocks delete/overwrite until explicit approval.
pass_criteria: No delete or overwrite occurs without explicit approval; blocked actions are explained.
failure_cases: Deletes files without approval.
Overwrites existing files.
Does not distinguish reversible from destructive operations.

requirement: Find/open a PDF and summarize based on content.
small_test: Open this PDF and tell me what it is about.
larger_test: Open one of the folders on my desktop, find a PDF inside it, open it, and explain what the PDF is about.
message: Open the desktop folder {{desktop_folder}}, find the PDF inside it, and tell me what the PDF is about.
expected_behavior: The agent locates the PDF and summarizes its extracted content, not just the filename.
pass_criteria: The summary mentions content from the fixture PDF about automation, browser testing, or artifact delivery.
failure_cases: Summary is based only on filename.
Wrong file opened.
PDF content extraction error is hidden.

requirement: Open a browser, navigate to a website, verify, and screenshot.
small_test: Open the browser and go to example.com.
larger_test: Open the browser, go to this website, wait for the page to load, tell me what page opened, and send me a screenshot.
message: Open the browser, go to {{fixture_base_url}}/index.html, wait for it to load, tell me what page opened, and send me a screenshot.
expected_behavior: The browser reaches the target page, verifies title/url, captures screenshot, and sends it.
pass_criteria: The screenshot and reported URL/title match the fixture page.
failure_cases: Wrong tab captured.
Page did not load.
No screenshot delivered.

requirement: Inspect the actual desktop and summarize visible items.
small_test: Tell me what is on my desktop right now.
larger_test: Look at my desktop, identify the visible files, folders, apps, and open windows, and summarize what you see.
message: Tell me what is on my desktop right now.
expected_behavior: The agent observes the real desktop state and reports visible windows, apps, and desktop items when available.
pass_criteria: The response is grounded in the desktop observation and does not invent unrelated items.
failure_cases: No desktop observation tool ran.
The reply guesses without screenshot or UI evidence.
The summary lists unrelated items.

requirement: Use the local code interpreter to write and execute a small generated script in a managed workspace.
small_test: Use the local code interpreter to create a small report file.
larger_test: Ask the local LLM to generate a bounded Python script, save it in a temporary workspace, execute it, and report stdout plus created files.
message: Use the local code interpreter to create a file named interpreter-report.txt with a two-line summary of this test, run the script, and tell me where the file is.
expected_behavior: The orchestrator routes to code.interpreter, generates Python through the local LLM, runs it inside a managed workspace, and reports created files.
pass_criteria: The interpreter workspace contains the generated script and interpreter-report.txt; the final reply includes the workspace path or created file.
failure_cases: The request is routed to Codex or Copilot without being asked.
The generated code is not executed.
Files are written outside the managed interpreter workspace.

requirement: Send a found/opened PDF file back to the user.
larger_test: Find the PDF we just discussed, attach it or export it, and send it back to me.
message: Send me the PDF file at {{pdf_path}}.
expected_behavior: The agent resolves the requested PDF and sends the actual file through Telegram.
pass_criteria: Telegram receives the correct PDF file or a clear unavailable-file explanation.
failure_cases: Recent artifact cache is used instead of the requested path.
No Telegram media is sent.
Wrong file is delivered.

small_test: Create a job that runs every day and checks this website.
larger_test: Set up a scheduled job that runs every morning, searches the internet for this topic, summarizes new results, and sends me the summary.
message: Create a job that runs every day and checks {{episode_url}} for a new episode, then sends me the summary.
expected_behavior: The agent creates a schedule with cadence, objective, and output behavior.
pass_criteria: A schedule record exists with next run time and task definition.
failure_cases: No schedule created.
Schedule has no output channel.
Objective is not preserved.

requirement: Call a configured fake MCP echo tool and surface the actual tool result.
small_test: Use the fake MCP echo tool to echo hello from E2E.
larger_test: Use a configured test MCP server, call its echo tool, and return the echoed payload to Telegram.
message: Use the fake MCP echo tool to echo hello from E2E.
expected_behavior: The agent calls mcp.client call_tool with the configured fake server and echo tool.
pass_criteria: Telegram reply contains the echoed text from the MCP tool result.
failure_cases: Only the generic 'Called MCP tool' summary is returned.
The planner invents mcp.fake.echo as a direct tool name.
The result payload is hidden from synthesis.

requirement: Create/configure a reusable adapter for a missing capability.
small_test: Create an adapter for the Yahoo Finance stock data API that can fetch the latest price, daily change, and basic quote information for a given ticker symbol.
larger_test: I need an adapter that lets the orchestrator interact with VS Code, send prompts to Codex, read Codex output, detect file changes, and report progress.
message: Create an adapter for the Yahoo Finance stock data API that can fetch the latest price, daily change, and basic quote information for a given ticker symbol. Put it in the adapter cache and do not load it automatically.
expected_behavior: The system designs a reusable adapter proposal, isolates it in cache, and records review/activation status.
pass_criteria: Adapter proposal files exist and are generic, not hard-coded for one ticker.
failure_cases: Adapter is hardcoded to one prompt.
Proposal is auto-loaded without review.
No tests or manifest are created.
